most_relevant.description:
Had a great experience at Shiver Garden! The ambiance is beautiful with lots of greenery, cozy seating, and small water features that create a very relaxing vibe. They also have fun options like games and karaoke, which makes the place lively and enjoyable.

The staff is very polite and friendly, adding to the overall experience. Drinks and presentation were good too.

Only suggestion would be to add more vegetarian options to the menu.

Overall, a lovely place to visit—definitely recommended! 🌿✨

Shivers Garden Restaurant is a wonderful destination for anyone looking to enjoy delicious food in a relaxing and beautifully maintained outdoor setting. From the moment you arrive, the restaurant creates a welcoming atmosphere with its lush greenery, well-designed garden layout, and comfortable seating arrangements. The ambiance strikes a perfect balance between elegance and comfort, making it suitable for family gatherings, casual outings, celebrations, and even romantic dinners.

One of the standout aspects of Shivers Garden Restaurant is its diverse menu. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes that cater to different tastes and preferences. Whether you are a fan of traditional cuisine, seafood specialties, grilled delicacies, or vegetarian options, there is something for everyone. The ingredients appear fresh, and the dishes are prepared with great attention to flavor, presentation, and quality. Every meal is served in generous portions, providing excellent value for money.

We recently visited this place during our stay in Goa and were truly impressed. Despite the short notice, the team went above and beyond to arrange a beautiful anniversary celebration for us. Their dedication and effort were evident in every detail.

The hospitality of the staff was exceptional—they made us feel welcome and valued throughout our time there. Every moment felt thoughtfully curated and genuinely special.

The food was delicious, and the ambience was perfect—elegant, warm, and inviting. A heartfelt thank you to everyone there for adding a golden touch to our celebration and making it truly unforgettable.

I went with my family to have lobster and other food variety. Ordered Lobster which was nicely cooked with right amount of spices as told to server. We also had their burnt garlic noodles which were good too.

They also offered welcome drink prepared from Kumkum which was good in taste.

Also drinks which we ordered were nice and refreshing. They also have 4 rooms which people can take on rent, property is near to a beach.

Overall, good Experience.

This Bar & Restaurant is in Candolim area well known for its Seafood Thali. It was my lunch time around 1PM and I thought of trying their Seafood Thali, so I reached there with my wife and found that restaurant is completely empty there are no one around. There is only one waitress available so I asked her directly about the Seafood Thali and she told we don't have at the moment. So we really got disappointed with that. But they have other quick options available, so I ordered a KF beer pint and a open Paneer Bao in BBQ Sauce as starter. She brought a Welcome Kokum Drink in Test tubes for us which was lovely. We both liked the welcome Drink so I asked if we have the same to order. Then I ordered Khatta Meetha Kokum which she brought in a Big glass and that was so refreshing. Open Paneer Bao was also freshly prepared, it's Bao Bun was so soft and Paneer stuffing was really tasty. We also ordered Thai Veg Green Curry and Steamed Rice but took so much of time. As I have my work meeting to attend, so we asked her to Parcel the Curry and rice so that we can reach our hotel on time before the meeting start. Thai Curry was prepared in so hurry that it doesn't have creaminess, thickness and the proper amount of vegetables in it. It only has runny watery gravy with some Thai herb flavour which we somehow managed to finish our rice. Their ambience was really good but their service and quality of food they should have to improve. They are a bit expensive too as compared to other restaurants around.

The menu was quite confusing, and the service was rather slow. While the staff was very polite, I have visited this restaurant multiple times over the years. I believe there may have been a change in ownership, and perhaps, with more time, the new owners will enhance the overall service.

Had the best experience at this place. A happy ending to my short goa trip at this absolute gem of a place at Candolim. Seafood was fresh and delicious. Very attentive and cooperative staffs trying their best to make it the most pleasant experience for you. Loved the ambience and the light romantic music. Definitely coming back to this place again :)

I had an amazing experience dining here. From the savoury flavours to the hospitality, it was top notch. If you are visiting Goa, it should a must go in your Itinerary and about the hospitality, our host was this guy named Deepanshu, and he is so humble and welcoming and he made us experience the best service.
